items.summary: Recommendation: keep SearchWoot private and authorize only the prepared written permission request to Woot; do not change launch status. Evidence: official API access is documented, but public/commercial reuse rights remain unconfirmed; legal, security, accuracy, privacy, and measurement gates are still open. The fleet has 174 approved proposals without execution, 46 failed-request follow-ups, and 24 deployed improvements awaiting measurement, so no new production work should be added this cycle. Amazon attribution covers one day (2026-09-21): 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, $4.92 aggregate commission, with site-level income unavailable. AI cost was $948.88 from 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-26. Unknown: contribution margin, causal lift, ROI, and operational health because required sweeps are unavailable. Smallest next step: owner decides whether Legal may send the prepared Woot permission request.
